# Vendored browser builds

Reproduce with `cd site-tools && npm ci && npm run vendor`. Versions are pinned in `site-tools/package.json`.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js`, `DrawSVGPlugin.min.js` | [gsap](https://gsap.com) | 3.15.0 | GSAP Standard "no charge" licence, https://gsap.com/standard-license (header kept in each file) |
| `lenis.min.js`, `lenis.css` | [lenis](https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis) | 1.3.11 | MIT, see `LICENSE-lenis.txt` |
